<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title.

## Motivation

Currently we are using the last torch 2.15 nightly in the cuda 13.4 container. To help prepare for transition to torch 2.15, update to 2.15rc1.

Note: needs https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45857 to fix the build in general

## Modifications

Use 2.15 release candidate, remove references to "nightly" 

## Accuracy Tests

Tested qwen 0.7b gsm8k as a sanity check

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

files.patch:
@@ -1,15 +1,11 @@
 # CUDA 13.4 only args
-# Torch nighly args
-ARG TORCH_NIGHTLY_INDEX=https://download.pytorch.org/whl/nightly/cu134
-ARG TORCH_NIGHTLY_VERSION=2.15.0.dev20261005+cu134
-ARG TORCHVISION_NIGHTLY_VERSION=0.30.0.dev20261005+cu134
-ARG TORCHAUDIO_NIGHTLY_VERSION=2.11.0.dev20261004+cu134
+# Torch 2.15.0 RC1 from the PyTorch test channel; move to whl/cu134 once 2.15.0 is released.
 # Torch wheels may differ from the CUDA 13.4 toolkit used for JIT (e.g. cu130 stable
-# wheels on Blackwell). The nightly arguments stay as defaults for existing invocations.
-ARG TORCH_INDEX_URL=${TORCH_NIGHTLY_INDEX}
-ARG TORCH_VERSION=${TORCH_NIGHTLY_VERSION}
-ARG TORCHVISION_VERSION=${TORCHVISION_NIGHTLY_VERSION}
-ARG TORCHAUDIO_VERSION=${TORCHAUDIO_NIGHTLY_VERSION}
+# wheels on Blackwell); override these four arguments to select other wheels.
+ARG TORCH_INDEX_URL=https://download.pytorch.org/whl/test/cu134
+ARG TORCH_VERSION=2.15.0+cu134
+ARG TORCHVISION_VERSION=0.29.2+cu134
+ARG TORCHAUDIO_VERSION=2.11.1+cu134
 # source: build sglang-kernel / sgl-deep-gemm / sgl-deep-ep from source; pypi: download released wheels.
 ARG SGL_WHEELS_SOURCE=source
 ARG SGL_KERNEL_VERSION=0.4.10
@@ -51,7 +47,7 @@ ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive \
 ENV TRITON_PTXAS_PATH=/usr/local/cuda-13.4/bin/ptxas \
     TRITON_PTXAS_BLACKWELL_PATH=/usr/local/cuda-13.4/bin/ptxas
 
-# Turn off torch.distributed's NCCL2 path in the torch nightly.
+# Turn off torch.distributed's NCCL2 path in torch 2.15.
 ENV TORCH_DIST_USE_NCCL2=0
 
 # Add GKE default lib and bin locations
@@ -531,8 +527,8 @@ RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/pip \
         "peft==0.18.1" \
     && python3 -c "import importlib.util as u; missing = [m for m in ('cosmos_guardrail', 'retinaface', 'better_profanity', 'nltk', 'cv2', 'peft', 'sentencepiece') if u.find_spec(m) is None]; assert not missing, f'guardrail deps missing: {missing}'"
 
-# constraints.txt pins the cu134 nightly torch, which does not exist on PyPI;
-# later stages cannot satisfy it without the nightly index in scope.
+# constraints.txt pins the cu134 torch, which does not exist on PyPI;
+# later stages cannot satisfy it without the cu134 torch index in scope.
 RUN if [ "$CUDA_VERSION" = "13.4.1" ]; then \
         python3 -m pip config set global.extra-index-url "${TORCH_INDEX_URL}"; \
     fi
@@ -780,8 +776,9 @@ RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/pip \
 # Install essential Python packages (use constraints to prevent conflicts)
 #
 # pip only considers pre-release candidates when the requirement itself names
-# one, so the constraints-pinned cu134 nightly must be restated here; otherwise
-# runai-model-streamer's "torch<3.0.0,>=2.0.0" backtracks the whole resolve.
+# one, so the constraints-pinned cu134 torch is restated here in case it is a
+# nightly; otherwise runai-model-streamer's "torch<3.0.0,>=2.0.0" backtracks the
+# whole resolve.
 RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/pip \
     if [ "$CUDA_VERSION" = "13.4.1" ]; then TORCH_SPEC="torch==${TORCH_VERSION}"; else TORCH_SPEC=""; fi \
     && python3 -m pip install -c /sgl-workspace/constraints.txt \
@@ -865,7 +862,7 @@ ARG SGL_VERSION
 ARG USE_LATEST_SGLANG
 
 # TODO(Jialin): Set SGLANG_RUST_BUILD_MODE=never after Rust TreeCore supports
-# the PyTorch 2.15 nightly used by this preview image.
+# the PyTorch 2.15 used by this preview image.
 
 WORKDIR /sgl-workspace
 
@@ -1021,7 +1018,7 @@ ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive \
 ENV TRITON_PTXAS_PATH=/usr/local/cuda-13.4/bin/ptxas \
     TRITON_PTXAS_BLACKWELL_PATH=/usr/local/cuda-13.4/bin/ptxas
 
-# Turn off torch.distributed's NCCL2 path in the torch nightly.
+# Turn off torch.distributed's NCCL2 path in torch 2.15.
 ENV TORCH_DIST_USE_NCCL2=0
 
 # Add GKE default lib and bin locations + CUDA compiler paths for FlashInfer JIT
